en.title: Frequently asked questions
en.subtitle: Everything you might be wondering before your first lesson.

items.q: How is Fidya different from a course platform?
items.a: Course platforms hand you a fixed library and hope you finish. Fidya engineers a curriculum backwards from your deadline and baseline, teaches it from peer-reviewed sources, and actively coaches you through Socratic dialogue until you can prove mastery.

items.q: What does '100% grounded citations' actually mean?
items.a: Every factual claim in your lessons carries an inline citation tag pointing to an exact chunk of a real source — arXiv papers, Wikipedia, or your own uploaded documents. A dedicated Fact-Checker agent verifies each sentence before it reaches your screen; anything unsupported is rewritten or dropped.

items.q: What if the AI doesn't know something?
items.a: It tells you. If retrieved sources are insufficient, the Synthesizer flags INSUFFICIENT_DATA and The Hunter fetches new references instead of fabricating content. You'll never silently receive invented material.

items.q: Can I bring my own documents?
items.a: Yes. Upload PDFs, Markdown, or text files into your private, namespace-isolated knowledge base. Your documents are cited with blue badges and take retrieval priority over public sources.

items.q: Is my data isolated from other users?
items.a: Strictly. Private documents live in per-user namespaces enforced server-side by the vector database at query time — cross-tenant leakage is structurally impossible.

items.q: What happens if I fall behind my schedule?
items.a: The Architect re-plans dynamically: remaining modules rebalance across the days left until your deadline based on your actual completion velocity.

id.title: Pertanyaan yang sering diajukan
id.subtitle: Semua yang mungkin kamu tanyakan sebelum pelajaran pertamamu.

items.q: Apa bedanya Fidya dengan platform kursus?
items.a: Platform kursus memberimu koleksi materi yang tetap lalu berharap kamu selesai. Fidya merancang kurikulum mundur dari tenggat dan titik awalmu, mengajarkannya dari sumber peer-reviewed, dan aktif mendampingimu lewat dialog Socratik sampai kamu bisa membuktikan penguasaan.

items.q: Apa arti sebenarnya dari '100% grounded citations'?
items.a: Setiap klaim faktual di pelajaranmu membawa tag sitasi inline yang menunjuk ke potongan persis dari sumber nyata — paper arXiv, Wikipedia, atau dokumen yang kamu unggah sendiri. Agen Fact-Checker khusus memverifikasi setiap kalimat sebelum sampai ke layarmu; apa pun yang tak didukung akan ditulis ulang atau dibuang.

items.q: Bagaimana kalau AI tidak tahu sesuatu?
items.a: Dia akan bilang. Jika sumber yang ditemukan tidak cukup, Synthesizer menandai INSUFFICIENT_DATA dan The Hunter mencari referensi baru alih-alih mengarang konten. Kamu tidak akan pernah diam-diam menerima materi buatan.
Boleh. Unggah PDF, Markdown, atau file teks ke basis pengetahuan privatmu yang terisolasi per-namespace. Dokumenmu disitasi dengan badge biru dan diprioritaskan di atas sumber publik saat retrieval.

items.q: Apakah dataku terisolasi dari pengguna lain?
items.a: Sepenuhnya. Dokumen privat tersimpan di namespace per-pengguna yang ditegakkan server-side oleh vector database saat query — kebocoran lintas-tenant mustahil secara struktural.

items.q: Apa yang terjadi jika saya tertinggal dari jadwal?
items.a: The Architect menyusun ulang rencana secara dinamis: modul yang tersisa diseimbangkan ke hari-hari tersisa sampai tenggatmu, berdasarkan kecepatan penyelesaianmu yang sebenarnya.

faqs.q: How does the 100% grounded citation system work?
faqs.a: Every lesson is compiled by The Synthesizer, which must attach a [chunk_id] citation to each factual claim. The Fact-Checker agent then verifies every sentence against the original retrieved source before it reaches your screen. Unsupported claims are rewritten or stripped — never shown.

The Architect prunes beginner-level content (101 material, basic syntax walkthroughs, introductory definitions) and starts you at the level where retrieval, practice, and challenge match your declared baseline.

faqs.q: Can I upload my own documents?
faqs.a: Yes — BYOD (Bring Your Own Doc) lets Pro learners upload PDFs and Markdown files into a private, namespace-isolated vector store. Your documents are cited with blue badges and take priority over public sources during retrieval.

faqs.q: Why won't The Inquisitor just give me the answer?
faqs.a: By design (FR-5). Socratic questioning produces 2–3× better retention than answer-revealing. It identifies gaps in your reasoning, asks probing questions, and only provides hints when you're stuck.

faqs.q: What happens if I miss my deadline pace?
faqs.a: The Architect re-plans dynamically. Your remaining modules are rebalanced across the days left until your target deadline based on your actual completion velocity.

en.title: Privacy Policy
en.lead: Short version: your learning data is yours. We collect the minimum needed to teach you well, we never sell it, and you can delete everything at any time.

sections.title: 1. What we collect
body: Account data: your email address and display name when you sign in.
Learning data: your curricula, module progress, tutor conversations, mastery scores and analytics events — this is what makes Fidya personal.
Optional documents you upload (Bring-Your-Own-Data) are chunked, embedded and stored solely to ground your own lessons.
Newsletter subscribers: if you join our mailing list we store your email for product updates. Every email includes a one-click unsubscribe.

sections.title: 2. How we use it
body: To generate and re-plan your curriculum, score your mastery and send you gentle reminders you opted into.
To improve the product in aggregate: we look at anonymized usage patterns, never sell personal data to anyone.
AI providers process prompts to generate responses; we do not allow them to train on your data.

sections.title: 3. Your rights
body: Export: contact us anytime for a machine-readable export of your data.
Delete: deleting a curriculum or tutor conversation removes it permanently. Deleting your account removes everything associated with it within 30 days.
Questions about your data go to privacy@fidya.ai and are answered by a human.

id.lead: Versi singkatnya: data pembelajaran Anda adalah milik Anda. Kami hanya mengumpulkan data minimum yang dibutuhkan untuk membimbing Anda dengan baik, tidak pernah menjualnya, dan Anda dapat menghapus semuanya kapan saja.

en.title: Security
en.lead: Fidya Labs, Inc. treats the security of your learning data as a core product feature, not an afterthought. This page explains how we protect it — in transit, at rest, and inside every AI interaction.

encryption.title: Encryption in transit & at rest
body: All traffic to and from Fidya is encrypted with TLS 1.2+. Your documents, lessons, and account details are encrypted at rest in Supabase storage and databases using AES-256.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
body: Our data layer runs on Supabase Postgres with Row Level Security enabled: every row of learning data, curricula, and uploaded documents is isolated by user at the database engine level, so one account can never read another's data — even if application code fails.

authentication.title: Authentication
body: Sign-in is handled by Clerk. Sessions use short-lived, rotating tokens; credentials are hashed and never stored by us. You can sign out everywhere from your account settings.

aiSafety.title: AI safety
body: Lessons generated by SYNTAX pass through an automated Fact-Checker agent that verifies each claim against cited sources before you see it. Your learning data is never used to train models without your explicit consent.

access.title: Data access controls
body: Internal access follows least privilege: staff can only reach production data when required for support, with approval and audit logging. Every access event is recorded.

backups.title: Backups & uptime
body: Databases are backed up daily with point-in-time recovery. Live system health and incident history are published on our public status page.

en.vulnBody: Practice responsible disclosure and we will act fast. Email security@fidya.ai with reproduction steps. We acknowledge reports within 72 hours and will keep you informed until resolution. Please do not test against other users' accounts or data.

id.title: Keamanan
id.lead: Fidya Labs, Inc. memperlakukan keamanan data belajar Anda sebagai fitur inti produk, bukan pelengkap. Halaman ini menjelaskan cara kami melindunginya — saat transit, saat tersimpan, dan di dalam setiap interaksi AI.

encryption.title: Enkripsi saat transit & saat tersimpan
body: Semua lalu lintas ke dan dari Fidya dienkripsi dengan TLS 1.2+. Dokumen, pelajaran, dan detail akun Anda dienkripsi saat tersimpan di basis data dan penyimpanan Supabase menggunakan AES-256.

infrastructure.title: Infrastruktur
body: Lapisan data kami berjalan di atas Supabase Postgres dengan Row Level Security aktif: setiap baris data belajar, kurikulum, dan dokumen yang diunggah diisolasi per pengguna di tingkat mesin basis data, sehingga satu akun tidak akan pernah bisa membaca data akun lain — bahkan jika kode aplikasi gagal.

authentication.title: Autentikasi
body: Proses masuk ditangani oleh Clerk. Sesi menggunakan token berumur pendek yang dirotasi; kredensial di-hash dan tidak pernah disimpan oleh kami. Anda dapat keluar dari semua perangkat melalui pengaturan akun.

aiSafety.title: Keamanan AI
body: Pelajaran yang dihasilkan SYNTAX melewati agen Fact-Checker otomatis yang memverifikasi setiap klaim terhadap sumber yang dikutip sebelum Anda melihatnya. Data belajar Anda tidak pernah digunakan untuk melatih model tanpa persetujuan eksplisit Anda.

access.title: Kontrol akses data
body: Akses internal mengikuti prinsip hak istimewa minimum: staf hanya dapat menjangkau data produksi saat dibutuhkan untuk dukungan, dengan persetujuan dan pencatatan audit. Setiap peristiwa akses terekam.

backups.title: Cadangan & uptime
body: Basis data dicadangkan harian dengan pemulihan point-in-time. Kesehatan sistem langsung dan riwayat insiden dipublikasikan di halaman status publik kami.

id.vulnBody: Laporkan secara bertanggung jawab dan kami akan bertindak cepat. Kirim email ke security@fidya.ai beserta langkah reproduksi. Kami mengonfirmasi laporan dalam 72 jam dan akan terus mengabari Anda hingga selesai ditangani. Mohon jangan melakukan pengujian terhadap akun atau data pengguna lain.

en.title: Cookie Policy
en.lead: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We keep our use of them minimal: strictly necessary cookies to run the platform, and a few preference cookies so the product remembers you. We set no advertising or tracking cookies.
en.whatBody: A cookie is a small file that a website stores in your browser. Similar technologies such as localStorage work the same way: they let a site remember state between visits. This policy covers both, and “cookies” refers to all of them.

rowsNecessary.name: Session cookies — Clerk
rowsNecessary.purpose: Keep you signed in securely while you use Fidya and protect against session hijacking and CSRF attacks.
rowsNecessary.duration: Session or up to 7 days (remembered device)

rowsNecessary.name: Security cookies — Fidya infrastructure
rowsNecessary.purpose: Load balancing and protection against abuse, fraud, and denial-of-service attacks.

rowsNecessary.name: __theme — localStorage
rowsNecessary.purpose: Remembers whether you chose light or dark mode.

rowsAnalytics.name: Anonymous usage events — Fidya
rowsAnalytics.purpose: Aggregated product analytics such as page views and citation click counts. Contains no lesson content and is never linked to advertising identifiers.

rowsPreferences.name: Locale — localStorage
rowsPreferences.purpose: Remembers your chosen interface language (English or Bahasa Indonesia).

rowsPreferences.name: Onboarding & UI state — localStorage
rowsPreferences.purpose: Remembers dismissible tips and layout preferences so they stay out of your way.

en.retentionBody: Strictly necessary cookies last only as long as your session (or up to 7 days on a remembered device). Preference values in localStorage persist until you clear your browser data. Aggregated analytics events are kept for at most 12 months and are not tied to your identity.
en.noAdsBody: Fidya does not currently set any advertising, retargeting, or cross-site tracking cookies. If this ever changes, we will update this policy and ask for your consent where required by law before setting them.
en.manageBody1: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings — every major browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) lets you block, review, or remove them at any time.
en.manageBody2: If you disable strictly necessary cookies, signing in will stop working because Clerk cannot maintain your secure session. Disabling preference storage means your language and theme reset on every visit; the core learning experience remains fully usable.
en.contactBody: Questions about this policy or the data stored on your device: privacy@fidya.ai

Anda dapat membatalkan kapan saja; akses tetap berlanjut hingga akhir periode tagihan yang sedang berjalan. Penurunan paket berlaku pada awal siklus berikutnya.

Jaminan Penyelesaian: pelanggan Pro yang menyelesaikan kurang dari 80% silabus Minggu-1 mereka karena kesalahan platform berhak mengklaim satu bulan gratis per kejadian, dengan verifikasi dari tim dukungan kami.

sections.title: 4. Penggunaan yang Diperbolehkan
body: Anda tidak boleh: (a) menjual kembali, mendistribusikan ulang, atau melakukan scraping konten Layanan termasuk materi pelajaran dan sitasi; (b) mencoba mengakses namespace privat atau data pengguna lain; (c) mengunggah file yang melanggar hukum, melanggar hak cipta, atau berbahaya ke penyimpanan dokumen Anda; (d) melakukan reverse engineering terhadap pipeline multi-agent atau menghindari batas laju (rate limits).
Dokumen yang Anda unggah tetap menjadi milik Anda. Anda memberi kami lisensi terbatas untuk memprosesnya semata-mata guna menyediakan fitur retrieval dan sitasi dalam akun Anda sendiri.

sections.title: 5. Konten Hasil AI & Pembumian (Grounding)
body: Pelajaran dihasilkan oleh AI agent yang diwajibkan menyertakan sitasi sumber untuk setiap klaim faktual, dan diverifikasi pasca-pembuatan melalui proses pemeriksaan fakta otomatis.

Meskipun kami menegakkan kebijakan tanpa klaim tanpa dasar (zero-ungrounded-claim), keluaran AI tetap dapat mengandung kesalahan atau kelalaian. Materi disediakan untuk tujuan pendidikan dan bukan merupakan nasihat profesional. Selalu rujuk sumber primer untuk keputusan penting.

sections.title: 6. Sumber Akademik & Atribusi
body: Pengetahuan publik diambil dari API terbuka termasuk arXiv, Wikipedia, dan Semantic Scholar, dan tetap menjadi milik penulis serta penerbit masing-masing. Sitasi tertaut ke sumber aslinya sehingga Anda dapat memverifikasi setiap klaim secara mandiri.
Jika Anda pemegang hak dan yakin ada konten yang terindeks secara tidak semestinya, hubungi legal@fidya.ai dan kami akan segera menghapusnya.

sections.title: 7. Penafian & Pembatasan Tanggung Jawab
body: Layanan disediakan “sebagaimana adanya” tanpa jaminan dalam bentuk apa pun. Sejauh diizinkan oleh hukum, total tanggung jawab Fidya Labs dibatasi maksimal sebesar jumlah yang telah Anda bayarkan kepada kami dalam dua belas bulan sebelum klaim diajukan.

Kami tidak bertanggung jawab atas kerugian tidak langsung, insidental, atau konsekuensial, termasuk waktu belajar yang hilang, kehilangan data akibat kesalahan pengguna, atau dampak dari mengandalkan konten pendidikan.

sections.title: 8. Pengakhiran
body: Anda dapat menghapus akun Anda kapan saja melalui Settings → Danger Zone, yang secara permanen menghapus kurikulum, dokumen, dan riwayat belajar Anda.
Kami dapat mengakhiri akun yang melanggar ketentuan ini, dengan pemberitahuan jika memungkinkan.
